summary: Add explicit SingleCamera product operation without weakening DualCamera A0 stitching: no mode inference or automatic fallback, initial SingleCamera exactly-one D810, canonical-original explicit export, Stitch NotApplicable, and read-only settings.
breaking_changes: legacy capture-single, capture-pair, and stability commands are fake-only and cannot open SDK or WPD hardware transports
all real-camera Phase 0 CLI commands now require one operator-session-wide named OS lease in addition to per-session guards; other user sessions and services are outside the MVP operating contract
SingleCamera and DualCamera are explicit immutable transaction modes and connected count never selects or downgrades the mode
initial SingleCamera requires exactly one SDK and WPD D810 projection and does not operate one selected body while two are connected
SingleCamera produces one canonical original with Stitch NotApplicable and explicit byte-identical export; camera settings remain read-only
non_completion_guards: existing software, simulated, and one-camera Phase 0 evidence does not prove the new SingleCamera WPF workflow, real Camera Agent integration, real one-camera capture and export, two-camera operation, approved A0 quality, or release readiness
DualCamera camera shortage must remain a blocker and must never trigger SingleCamera automatic fallback
SingleCamera target size, DPI, crop, future processing, performance, and durability remain gated by HG-0009
one-camera setting readback remains Partial until WI-0010A records native SDK command trace and resolves or explicitly preserves opaque capability meanings
synthetic measurement in WI-0022C must not introduce unapproved product thresholds or mutate a rig profile
dedicated empty-card capture and physical fault operations remain deferred until the operator explicitly resumes them
the known 90-object spool state must not be rechecked repeatedly without a reported physical state change
existing camera-card objects, bulk deletion, formatting, vendor operation 0x9207, and automatic retry remain prohibited
